cancellation.headline: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.content: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the tour start time. Cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations qualify for full refund or free rescheduling.
points: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before tour start time
Cancellations within 24 hours: non-refundable
No-shows: non-refundable
Weather-related cancellations: full refund or free rescheduling
Refunds processed within 5–7 business days

booking.headline: Booking Terms & Conditions
booking.content: By booking a tour with Addis Ababa City Tour, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
points: Minimum booking: 24 hours in advance
Confirmation: Instant email confirmation upon booking
Voucher: Present email confirmation or mobile voucher to guide
Pickup: Complimentary pickup from central Addis Ababa hotels (Bole, Piassa, Meskel Square)
Punctuality: Tours depart on time. Late arrivals may result in missed tour (no refund)
Age restrictions: Most tours suitable for ages 6+. Menagesha Forest recommended for ages 12+
Fitness level: Most tours require moderate walking (2–5 km). Menagesha Forest requires good fitness
Wheelchair accessibility: Most tours not wheelchair accessible. Bishoftu Crater Lakes is wheelchair accessible
Dietary restrictions: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free options available with advance notice
Photography: Allowed at most sites. Restricted inside churches—ask permission
Liability: Participants join tours at their own risk. We carry full liability insurance

pricing.headline: Pricing & Payment
pricing.content: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Book direct and save 15% compared to online travel agencies.
points: Prices shown are per person in USD
Children (6–17 years): discounted rates
Infants (0–5 years): free
Private tours: priced by group size (1–2, 3–4, 5–6 people)
Small group tours: per-person pricing
Payment methods: USD, EUR, ETB (Ethiopian Birr), credit cards (Visa, Mastercard)
Cash payments: accepted on tour (exact change appreciated)
No hidden fees: all entrance fees, guide, vehicle, and lunch (where included) are in the price
Gratuities: optional, not included
Personal expenses: not included (shopping, additional meals, beverages)
